[6] Mind! [7] I don't mean to say that I know, of my own knowledge, what there is particularly dead about a door-nail. [8] I might have been inclined, myself, to regard a coffin-nail as the deadest piece of ironmongery in the trade. [9] But the wisdom of our ancestors is in the simile; and my unhallowed hands shall not disturb it, or the Country's done for. [10] You will therefore permit me to repeat, emphatically, that Marley was as dead as a door-nail.

[11] Scrooge knew he was dead? [12] Of course he did. [13] How could it be otherwise? [14] Scrooge and he were partners for I don't know how many years. [15] Scrooge was his sole executor, his sole administrator, his sole assign, his sole residuary legatee, his sole friend, and sole mourner.
